name: agent_run_events
sql:
CREATE TABLE `agent_run_events` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`run_id` text NOT NULL,
	`message` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`run_id`) REFERENCES `agent_runs`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

name: agent_runs
sql:
CREATE TABLE `agent_runs` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'running' NOT NULL,
	`label` text,
	`started_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`completed_at` integer,
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

name: artifacts
sql:
CREATE TABLE `artifacts` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`kind` text DEFAULT 'markdown' NOT NULL,
	`content` text DEFAULT '' NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL, `prototype_id` text REFERENCES prototypes(id), `x` real, `y` real, `folder_id` text REFERENCES folders(id),
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

name: comments
sql:
CREATE TABLE `comments` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`target_type` text NOT NULL,
	`target_id` text NOT NULL,
	`passage` text,
	`anchor` text,
	`body` text NOT NULL,
	`resolved` integer DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

name: documents
sql:
CREATE TABLE "documents" (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`title` text NOT NULL,
	`body` text,
	`status_line` text,
	`parent_id` text,
	`folder_id` text,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL, `source_path` text, `verified_at` integer, `verified_ref` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`parent_id`) REFERENCES `documents`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`folder_id`) REFERENCES `folders`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

name: edges
sql:
CREATE TABLE "edges" (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`from_type` text NOT NULL,
	`from_id` text NOT NULL,
	`to_type` text NOT NULL,
	`to_id` text NOT NULL,
	`label` text,
	`arrow_direction` text,
	`style` text,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

name: files
sql:
CREATE TABLE `files` (
	`id` text NOT NULL,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`filename` text NOT NULL,
	`mime` text NOT NULL,
	`size` integer NOT NULL,
	`bytes` blob,
	`external_url` text,
	`created_at` text NOT NULL,
	PRIMARY KEY(`project_id`, `id`),
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

name: folders
sql:
CREATE TABLE `folders` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`parent_folder_id` text,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`parent_folder_id`) REFERENCES `folders`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

name: goals
sql:
CREATE TABLE `goals` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`objective` text NOT NULL,
	`status` text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
	`verification_surface` text,
	`constraints` text,
	`boundaries` text,
	`iteration_policy` text,
	`stop_condition` text,
	`budget` text,
	`last_verification` text,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL, `name` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

sql:
CREATE TABLE "guest_sessions" (

	`workspace_id` text,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`email` text,
	`token_hash` text NOT NULL,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`revoked_at` integer,
	FOREIGN KEY (`share_id`) REFERENCES `shares`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)

sql:
CREATE TABLE `projects` (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`org_id` text NOT NULL,
	`name` text NOT NULL,
	`description` text,
	`canvas_layout` text,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL
, `workspace_id` text DEFAULT '00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000a2' NOT NULL, `repo_url` text, `folder_path` text, `owner_id` text, `overview_document_id` text REFERENCES documents(id), `current_goal_id` text REFERENCES goals(id))

name: tasks
sql:
CREATE TABLE "tasks" (
	`id` text PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
	`project_id` text NOT NULL,
	`goal_id` text,

	`status` text DEFAULT 'todo' NOT NULL,
	`kind` text DEFAULT 'build' NOT NULL,
	`priority` text,
	`lane` text,
	`severity` text,
	`description` text,
	`x` real DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,

	`due_date` integer,
	`commit_refs` text,
	`created_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL,
	`updated_at` integer DEFAULT (cast((julianday('now') - 2440587.5)*86400000 as integer)) NOT NULL, `verified_at` integer, `verified_ref` text,
	FOREIGN KEY (`project_id`) REFERENCES `projects`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action,
	FOREIGN KEY (`goal_id`) REFERENCES `goals`(`id`) ON UPDATE no action ON DELETE no action
)
